title: An AI-powered patient triage platform for future viral outbreaks using COVID-19 as a disease model
summary: Machine learning combining clinical, comorbidity and metabolomics data predicted hospitalization outcomes in SARS-CoV-2 patients, with a defined clinical cohort and measured outcome evaluation.
